title: Core: AS2 string methods compilation
description: Verify String method calls compile correctly in the AS2 compiler. str.charAt(i), str.charCodeAt(i), str.indexOf(s), str.lastIndexOf(s), str.split(sep), str.substring(i,j), str.substr(i,n), str.toUpperCase(), str.toLowerCase(), str.replace(pattern, repl), str.length should all compile as ActionCallMethod or ActionGetMember. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/stringmethods.test.ts.
